question: How is the divine lotus of the first octad described for meditation?
premises: It has eight spokes or divisions.
It is adorned by the first octad.
inference: The meditation object is a divine eight-spoked lotus adorned by the first octad.
uncertainties: āraṃ is taken as spoked in line with the legacy hint.
plain_english: Meditate on the divine eight-spoked lotus adorned by the first octad.
